properties.description: Class tests for req:designs-are-shown-where-they-already-touch-before-anyone-declares-it across evidence kinds (location in one repository, equal checksum, pin by graph_id, pin by repository, bare common filenames, name only), across two designs (the one-other-design call, pair_designs) and several (other_graph_ids, tracked_designs), and across pin states (missing export, address): exact evidence is a drawn computed link that threads a member to the others; a bare path or stock checksum is set aside; a name is a candidate only; every pair has a link_status; the one-other-design reply only gains the link fields; nothing is written.
